text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Aw, man. I was completely
in the mood for croquettes from here...
I even saved up an appetite.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She missed out on eating the favorite food she had longed for.
Mr. C.B.'s stomach let out a lonely rumble,
as if crying out in hunger...
